entry.title: Daily census: 33 of 44 moved since the pin
entry.summary: 33 of the 44 assessed repositories have commits after their pinned commit (3007 commits in all). 4 flagged a change that could move a verdict cell (a release, tag, license, or workflow-set change), which is what triggers a re-check. Commits alone never change a verdict. Source: watch/census/2026-09-24.tsv.
